question: Stack: on 4% days with explosive volume (rvol50>=3), does buying near the 21d low (bounce_low21) still help, testing whether Zanger's volume-explosion combines with position-in-range? Expect no added edge beyond what bounce_low21 already showed on the plain bounce trigger.
plain: We take only the 4%-up days with the biggest volume explosions (Dan Zanger's core idea) and check whether stocks trading near their recent low do better than those further away.
